description: This file defines the main landing page component for a Next.js React application, including UI elements, layout, and interactions such as smooth scrolling and event handling. It includes multiple sections with static content, buttons, links, and embedded components for a marketing/starter page.

classes.name: GlassRolePill
classes.description: A UI component representing a stylized pill with role information and visual signals.

classes.name: HoverLiftCard
classes.description: A UI card component with hover effects for presenting information.

classes.name: TimelineLane
classes.description: A component representing a timeline segment in the roadmap section, displaying bullets and labels.

methods.name: scrollToCareerGps
methods.description: Implements smooth scrolling to the 'career-gps' section when invoked.

methods.name: useRevealOnScroll
methods.description: Custom React hook that uses IntersectionObserver to animate elements on scroll.
